meta.title: Mahanadi Coalfields IPO: ₹9,000 Cr PSU Trap or Dividend Gem?
meta.instagramCaption:
Mahanadi Coalfields ka ₹9,000 Crore mega IPO aa raha hai! Lekin kya is sarkari issue me paisa lagana chahiye ya ye LIC jaisa trap banega? 👇

Key Breakdown:
⚡ 25% Power Supply: Aapke ghar ki bijli aur AC jis koyla se chalti hai, uska 25% Coal India ki yahi subsidiary produce karti hai!
🛡️ Zero Debt & Cash Rich: Company par ₹0 karza hai aur tijori saalon se cash aur profits se bhari hai!
⚠️ Cold ₹3 GMP (3% Gain): Sarkari PSU IPOs listing par lottery nahi lagate! Sirf 3% gain ke liye 1-day listing investors ka capital LIC ki tarah phans sakta hai!

Verdict: 1-Day Listing Gain ke liye avoid karo! Lekin long-term regular dividend ke liye ye ek solid PSU stock ban sakta hai. Kya aap apply karoge? Comments me batao! 👇
